choices.reasoning: Keep this hand - it has 6 cards (max hand size) and all are useful for threat management, defense, and early game utility against Rhino. No reason to mulligan.
Change form to Spider-Man to access hero powers and play cards from hand. As Alter-Ego with no damage yet, I can safely switch to hero form.
Play Surveillance Team to add threat removal support with counters. This will help manage threat on the main scheme and the Scientist ability can generate mental resources.
Cannot pay for Surveillance Team - it needs 2 mental resources, but I don't have any cards in hand that provide mental resources. All my cards are physical or energy.
Play Aunt May using payment with Mockingbird (physical) and Spider-Tracer (energy) to get 3 physical + 1 energy = 4 resources total. I have Aunt May still in hand to play after payment.
Cancel payment - I was trying to play Aunt May, not Interrogation Room. Something seems wrong with the game state.
Play Aunt May using payment with Aunt May (energy) and Backflip (physical) to get 1 energy + 1 physical = 2 resources total. I still have Aunt May in hand to play.
Play Aunt May using payment with Spider-Tracer (energy) to get 1 energy. I still have Aunt May in hand to play after payment.
Play Interrogation Room using payment with Spider-Tracer (energy) to get 1 energy. I still have Interrogation Room in hand to play after payment.
Cancel payment - I can't pay for Interrogation Room with the available options. None of them give energy resources, and Interrogation Room costs 1 energy.
Basic attack on Rhino deals 2 damage without needing to discard cards. It's a valid action and I can change form or end turn afterward.
End turn. I've dealt damage to Rhino but can't play any cards due to resource limitations. Will go through villain phase next.
Done discarding. I have enough cards in hand and don't need to discard any. Will draw up to hand size next.
Defend with Spider-Man. DEF 3 reduces the attack damage from 2 to 0, preventing all damage.
Change form to Peter Parker. As alter-ego, Hydra Mercenary will scheme instead of attack, making the villain phase safer. I can heal if needed.
End turn. Can't play any cards due to resource limitations. Will go through villain phase next.
Done discarding. I have 6 cards in hand, which is my hand size of 6, so I don't need to discard any. Will draw up to hand size next.

Play Black Cat. She costs 2 energy and can help me get mental resources by discarding the top 2 cards of my deck and putting any with mental resources into my hand. This will allow me to play Surveillance Team.

Cannot pay for Black Cat with the available options. I need 2 energy resources, but the only card that gives energy is Black Cat herself (which I can't use to pay for herself) and Interrogation Room (which gives 1 energy). None of the payment options give 2 energy.
Play Web-Shooter. She costs 1 physical and can generate wild resources (which count as any type) to help pay for other cards. This is the best use of my hand right now.
Play Web-Shooter using payment with Mockingbird (physical) to get 1 physical resource. I still have Web-Shooter in hand to play after payment.
End turn. I've played Web-Shooter but still can't play any cards due to resource limitations. Will go through villain phase next.
Done discarding. I have 4 cards in hand, which is less than my hand size of 6. Will draw up to hand size next.
